_about: The Keynote (studied from a cinematic speaker clip): two framings of a speaker alternating every ~1.4 s, lowercase captions that build line by line with the key phrase in a gold handwritten script with a glow, warm light-leak flashes between sections, soft cinematic music bed. Caption size and height measured by OCR on the reference: 3 words, lowercase, ~6% of frame height, centred at 50%.

director.style: The Keynote: cinematic speaker edit. Part one (the problem) is designed and dramatic; part two (the answer) is calm.

keyword_treatments.script: gold handwritten script: aspiration, purpose, the future, faith, what the speaker is working towards
keyword_treatments.bold: huge bold accent word: the single core idea or number of a sentence (e.g. a hundred, purpose, three months)
keyword_treatments.alarm: red while the frame turns black and white: danger, loss, pain, what goes wrong (e.g. distracted, lose, punish)

director.icons: a gold icon tile when the speaker names something concrete and visual (a calendar for a time frame, a signpost for direction, a trophy for winning). Use Lucide icon names (lucide.dev), e.g. calendar-days, signpost, trophy, target, dumbbell, alarm-clock, heart, brain.

scenes.tv: TV montage when the speaker describes noise, distraction, other people, the crowd, or what everyone else does. 1.5-3 s.
scenes.window: framed vintage B-roll when the speaker describes doing something (writing, working, training, building). 1.5-3 s.
scenes.image: full-screen B-roll for a vivid moment the speaker paints with words. 1.5-3 s.

director.banner: optional: a 3-6 word hook for the first ~3 s when the opening line is weak.
director.restraint: Never two treatments in the same sentence. Leave the calm second half mostly plain.
